1052552071.description: If your mattress runs hot, the Serta® Cool Relief™ 4-Inch Pillow Top Gel Memory Foam Mattress Topper is the upgrade you've been waiting for. Designed with dual action cooling, it works on two levels simultaneously: a cool-touch cover that delivers instant relief the moment you lie down is paired with gel-infused memory foam, which provides continuous cool comfort throughout the night. Together, they create a cooler sleep environment from the first minute to the second you wake up.

1052552072.description: The Riedel Veloce Cabernet Glass Set combines elegance, innovation, and precision for wine lovers who appreciate full-bodied, complex red wines. Designed with a modern diamond shape, each glass enhances the aromas and flavors of bold New World wines by providing extra space for the bouquet to develop. Made from fine clear crystal glass, the Veloce collection feels light and refined while maintaining machine-made precision. This premium 4-piece setis dishwasher safe and ideal for showcasing the balance, richness, and depth of your favorite Cabernet and similar varietals.

1052552073.description: Bring commercial-grade cleaning to your home with the Roomba® Electro Plus 5-in-1 Disinfecting Hard Floor Cleaner. This innovative device vacuums, mops, and disinfects floors simultaneously using electrolyzed tap water—no harsh chemicals required. Designed for efficiency, it delivers professional-level results while being safe for kids, pets, and the environment.

1052552074.description: Nugget Ice. Pellet ice. Drive-in ice. Whatever you call it, you know it's "the good ice."

1052552075.description: Elevate your holiday table with these beautifully crafted natural marble serving boards. Featuring unique snowflake and Christmas tree silhouettes, these boards add a festive touch while providing a practical way to serve and display your favorite dishes.

1052552076.description: Transform your cooking routine with the Calphalon® Ceramic Nonstick Cookware Set. Designed for everyday use, this set is perfect for creating a variety of dishes, from simmering soups to sautéing vegetables. Its Quick Cleaning Technology ensures food doesn't stick, allowing you to spend more time enjoying your meals and less time cleaning up.

1052552077.description: Wrap yourself in the cloud-like softness of the Member's Mark Double Ruched Faux Fur Throw. Crafted with ultra-soft stretch faux fur on both sides, this throw offers a plush, high-end look and feel. The double-sided ruched texture adds rich dimension and an irresistibly touchable hand feel, making it a perfect blend of style and comfort.

1052552078.description: Transform your bedroom into a warm and inviting retreat with the Member's Mark™ Bridgewater Queen Bed. This beautifully crafted centerpiece showcases a light brown finish that highlights the natural wood grain, effortlessly complementing a variety of décor styles, from traditional farmhouse to casual transitional interiors. Perfect for both primary bedrooms and guest spaces, it adds a relaxed and welcoming feel to any room.

1052552079.description: The Wallace 20-Piece Flatware Set brings timeless craftsmanship and sophistication to your dining table. Designed for both special occasions and everyday meals, this set combines artistry with durability, ensuring every meal feels extraordinary.

1052552080.description: Transform your home bar into a mixologist's dream with the Houdini Noir 5-Piece Bar Tool Set. This comprehensive set includes five essential tools: a 550 ml cocktail shaker, a bar jigger, a cocktail strainer, a muddler, and a stirring spoon. Whether you're crafting classic cocktails or experimenting with new recipes, this set has everything you need to create drinks with precision and flair.

1052552081.description: Delight your little one with the Barefoot Dreams CozyChic Barefoot Buddie, a cuddly plush friend paired with an attached 15" x 17" mini blanket for double the comfort. Crafted from a machine-washable polyester knit and finished with silky satin trim, it's irresistibly soft and perfect for everyday hugs, travel, and gifting. Choose from a bear, bunny, or puppy to create a keepsake companion they'll treasure.

1052552082.description: Discover the Ninja® 14-in-1 PossibleCooker™ PRO 8.5-qt, a versatile multi-cooker designed to handle any recipe for any occasion. From intimate dinners to large gatherings, its cooker-to-oven-to-table functionality simplifies your cooking process, making it a must-have addition to your kitchen.

1052552085.description: Step into effortless comfort with the Isotoner Women's Faux-Suede Clog. Featuring a plush faux-fur cuff, these clogs provide a touch of warmth and luxury, while the soft microterry lining cradles your feet in gentle softness for a truly relaxing experience.

1052552086.description: OpenDots Air by Shokz offers a revolutionary open-ear listening experience with a sleek clip-on design tailored for all-day comfort and seamless movement. Weighing just 6.3g per earbud, these lightweight earbuds provide a breathable, barely-there feel, keeping you connected to your surroundings whether at home, work, or on the go.

1052552087.description: Get into the holiday spirit with the Burt's Bees Mini Mega Balm Lip Balm Collection, available exclusively at Sam's Club. This festive gift set features an oversized lip balm container filled with 10 full-size hydrating lip balms in a variety of holiday-inspired and classic flavors. Enjoy Salted Caramel, Vanilla Maple, Vanilla Bean, Cranberry Spritz, Peppermint, Wild Cherry, Pomegranate, Honey, Beeswax, and the Sam's Club exclusive Sugar Plum flavor.

1052552088.description: Member's Mark Grated Parmesan Cheese is a finely grated parmesan in a 24 oz. shaker bottle. Unlike shredded parmesan, shaved parmesan, or parmesan wedges, grated parmesan has a fine, powdery texture that dissolves quickly into hot dishes and distributes evenly as a finishing topping. It delivers a light, nutty flavor and is aged for 10 months.

1052552089.description: Don't let allergies keep you from enjoying your day. Member's Mark Aller-Zyr, Cetirizine Hydrochloride Tablets, 10mg are designed to provide relief from common allergy symptoms such as sneezing, runny nose, itchy nose or throat, and itchy, watery eyes. The active ingredient in these allergy pills, cetirizine HCl, is an antihistamine that is comparable to the active ingredient in Zyrtec. Whether you're indoors or outdoors, these tablets can help you manage your symptoms and get back to your daily activities.

1052552090.description: Compare to Prilosec OTC. Stop the painful burning sensation of frequent heartburn before it begins with Member's Mark™ Omeprazole Delayed Release Tablets 20 mg.

1052552091.description: Experience relief from a wide array of allergy symptoms with Member's Mark 50mcg Aller-Nose, Fluticasone Propionate Nasal Spray. This superior spray provides all-day relief from allergy-related symptoms. It's housed in a drip-free bottle that delivers a gentle, mess-free mist of nasal decongesting solution, soothing a variety of symptoms.

1052552092.description: Member's Mark Chicken Broth is one of those ingredients that you always want to have on hand in your kitchen. Whether homemade or boxed, chicken broth is a kitchen staple. One sip of ours and you might actually think it was homemade! It's that good. To get that rich, deep flavor, we make our broth with free range chickens. We then add a unique mix of fragrant herbs and vegetables to further deepen the flavor. The result is a golden broth that tastes like you personally cooked it on the stove for hours.

1052552093.description: Compare to Maximum Strength Pepcid AC active ingredient. Just one tablet of Member's Mark™ Acid-Pep Famotidine Tablets, 20 mg prevents and relieves heartburn associated with acid indigestion brought on by eating and drinking certain foods and beverages. This maximum strength heartburn medicine is intended for adults and children 12 years and over. Helps prevent meal-induced heartburn when taken at least 10-60 minutes before eating. Lasts up to 12 hours.

1052552094.description: The Member's Mark Full Motion Extended TV Wall Mount uses articulating dual swivel arms and heavy-gauge steel construction to securely position a 32"–100" TV with a wide range of viewing angles and a long reach from the wall.

1052552102.description: Experience a world of stunning visuals with cutting-edge AI technology that analyzes every scene in real time. From the soft hues of a sunset to the vibrant colors of a sports game, enjoy a richer, more dynamic viewing experience that brings your favorite content to life.

1052552105.description: The ILIVE Ultimate Theater Bundle brings the magic of the movies right into your home. Featuring a compact yet powerful digital projector, this bundle ensures a crystal-clear picture for an immersive viewing experience. Whether it's movie night or a big game, this setup is designed to impress.

1052552107.description: Bring holiday cheer to your home with the Member's Mark Pre-Lit Motion Activated Musical Mailbox. Standing 48 inches tall, this mailbox features a real mail slot and chasing marquee lights that create a magical ambiance. Approaching the mailbox activates one of four festive songs, while inserting a letter triggers the two-color changing candy cane for added excitement.

1052552108.description: The CyberPowerPC Gamer Supreme series delivers unparalleled gaming performance with cutting-edge processing power and the latest graphics cards. Designed to handle even the most demanding games, this gaming computer ensures a seamless and immersive experience for every gamer.

1052552110.description: Add a touch of elegance and warmth to your holiday celebrations with these 14-ounce Carousel candles. Crafted with a soy wax blend, these candles are encased in beautifully decorative containers, combining functionality with style. Designed to burn cleanly and slowly, they feature cotton wicks and premium scented oils that fill your space with captivating seasonal aromas.

1052552112.description: Experience entertainment like never before with the Monster Vision 3 portable speaker. Featuring a built-in 15.6" Full HD LCD display and powerful 100W peak audio, this innovative device is perfect for tailgating, camping, backyard gatherings, or beach days. Its rugged, portable design ensures you can take immersive sound and video wherever life takes you.

1052552115.description: The CyberPower GX150C2 UPS is designed for high-performance gaming setups, offering sine wave battery backup and advanced surge protection. Safeguard your gaming PC, monitor, and accessories from blackouts, brownouts, and voltage spikes, ensuring uninterrupted gameplay and hardware safety.

1052552116.description: Celebrate the holidays with the Member's Mark 9' Fraser Fir Downswept Pre-Lit Christmas Tree. Designed with mixed PE and PVC tips, this tree offers a lifelike appearance that mimics the beauty of a natural fir. Its perfect profile and realistic foliage make it a dazzling centerpiece for your home or business, ready to be adorned with Member's Mark ornaments for a festive touch.

1052552117.description: Member's Mark Fully Cooked Double Glazed Naturally Hardwood Smoked Boneless Brown Sugar Ham with Glaze Packet offers a mouthwatering experience with every bite. Expertly hardwood smoked and spiral sliced, this ham is ready to heat, slice, and serve, making it a convenient and tasty addition to your meals.

1052552118.description: Why settle for less when you can elevate your gaming experience with the Skytech Noir series? Featuring the latest NVIDIA RTX 40 series graphics cards and powered by an AMD Ryzen 7 Processor, this gaming rig delivers exceptional performance and value, making it a standout choice for gamers and creators alike.

1052552119.description: Make your holiday season unforgettable with the Member's Mark 32" Pre-lit Decorated Wreath, exclusively available at Sam's Club. Crafted with a mix of lush, life-like Noble fir, pine, cedar, and juniper, this wreath is adorned with gold glittered berries, faceted ornaments in sage green, champagne gold, pearlized and shiny red, and hunter green. Gold-painted cone clusters and faux red berries add a festive touch, while the velvet ribbon and gold faux pinecones at the center bring sophistication and drama. The removable pinecone cluster allows for customization, and a coordinating garland is available separately.

1052552120.description: Discover the magic of Member's Mark 9" New York Style Pumpkin Cheesecake, Frozen, 14 slices, a delightful fusion of pumpkin pie and New York-style cheesecake, topped with whipped cream. This scrumptious dessert, infused with warm spices like cinnamon and nutmeg, captures the essence of autumn. The frozen, pre-sliced cheesecake comes with parchment paper between each slice, making it a breeze to serve at Thanksgiving or to enjoy individual slices as desired.

1052552121.description: The Dell Inspiron 14" Copilot+ Laptop is designed to meet the demands of modern professionals, students, and remote workers. Powered by the Snapdragon® X Plus processor, this laptop delivers fast and responsive performance, making it perfect for managing spreadsheets, attending video meetings, creating presentations, and multitasking. With 16GB of RAM and a spacious 1TB M.2 PCIe NVMe SSD, you'll experience quick startup times, seamless performance, and ample storage for all your files and applications.

1052552123.description: Transform your holiday season with this stunning artificial tree, designed to bring the charm of nature into your home. Choose from three elegant styles: natural green, glistening icy, or flocked snow finish. Each tree features incredibly realistic, full branches that create a cozy and natural look, making it the perfect centerpiece for your festive decorations.

1052552124.description: Hey there. Have you tried our Member's Mark 12" Pumpkin Pie yet? If not, you're seriously missing out! It's a classic pumpkin pie with a flaky crust and a richly balanced filling made with brown sugar, 100% pumpkin puree, and just the right amount of cinnamon and spices. It's the perfect addition to your Fall, Thanksgiving or Christmas holiday feast.

1052552125.description: HomePod delivers groundbreaking, premium sound, from clear, detailed highs to deep, rich bass. Advanced computational audio pushes acoustics further. Spatial Audio¹provides even more immersive sound. Add more HomePod speakers for multiroom audio² and Intercom. Pair two speakers for stereo sound³or four speakers with Apple TV 4K for surround sound.⁴ Connect and control your smart home, privately and securely.⁵

1052552126.description: Create a magical holiday display with the Member's Mark Animated Deer Family. This exclusive set features three lifelike deer adorned with glittering material and removable red bows, adding elegance and charm to your outdoor décor. Illuminated with warm white LED lights and a cool white random fading effect, these deer bring sparkle and brightness to your yard, making them a standout decoration for the season.

1052552127.description: Pepperidge Farm Herb Seasoned Stuffing is crafted from premium toasted white and wheat bread, blended with a flavorful mix of herbs. Whether you call it dressing or stuffing, this delicious side dish is perfect for holiday gatherings or everyday meals. Its crushed bread texture adds a delightful touch to your culinary creations.

1052552128.description: Experience the elegance of Astra, a 12-inch HD frame adorned with stunning Swarovski Crystals. Its anti-glare display ensures your cherished photos and videos shine brightly, offering a crystal-clear view of your favorite moments.

1052552129.description: Transform your home into a festive wonderland with the Member's Mark® 7.5' Augusta Pine Pre-Lit Christmas Tree. Featuring 800 color-changing LED lights with twinkling effects, this tree creates a captivating and magical ambiance that will delight your family and guests.

1052552130.description: The Member's Mark Fresh-Cut Vegetable Tray with Ranch Dressing is an ideal choice for your next event. It eliminates the hassle of preparation, offering a washed, ready-to-eat, delicious, and healthy option that everyone will love. Whether it's a family gathering or a birthday party, this veggie tray is sure to be a hit.

1052552131.description: Add a touch of sophistication to your home with the Member's Mark Set of 3 Twinkling LED Globe Lights. Perfect for trees, roofs, porches, and more, these classic globes are designed to elevate your holiday décor effortlessly. With easy setup, simply unbox and display for instant charm.

1052552132.description: Experience seamless transcription with Plaud NotePro, the world's first ChatGPT-empowered AI voice recorder. Supporting 112 languages with speaker labels and custom vocabulary, it ensures accurate and efficient text conversion. Powered by OpenAI's Whisper STT model, Plaud NotePro transforms natural speech into text and processes it with ChatGPT 4.0 to create summaries, meeting minutes, to-do lists, and more, enhancing your productivity.

1052552133.description: Discover the irresistible taste of Member's Mark™ Roasted Red Pepper Hummus, a creamy and delectable delight packed with the vibrant flavor of red bell peppers. This 32-ounce tub of hummus is perfect for dipping with fresh veggies, chips, pretzels, and crackers, ensuring you'll never have a dull snacking moment.

1052552134.description: Elevate your holiday decorations with the Member's Mark Pre-Lit Twisted Foil Deer Family. This exclusive set features three lifelike deer crafted with elegant gold twisted foil material and adorned with removable red bows. Their dramatic presence, combined with warm white LED lights and a cool white random fading effect, brings sparkle and charm to your yard, creating a festive and magical atmosphere.

1052552135.description: Step into the magic of the season with the Carved Classic Nutcracker Décor Set of 3. These beautifully crafted nutcrackers bring the charm of traditional holiday folklore to life, featuring exquisite carved details, a classic color palette, and stoic expressions that add a touch of regal warmth to your festive décor.

1052552136.description: Member's Mark Italian Herb Grilled Chicken Breast is 100% flame-grilled NAE white meat chicken that has been marinated in a blend of savory Italian herbs such as rosemary and basil and garlic oil.

1052552137.description: Transform your yard into a winter wonderland with the Member's Mark Pre-Lit Peppermint Lawn Stake, Set of 5. These vibrant peppermints feature an iridescent glitter finish that adds a touch of sparkle to your holiday decorations. Perfect for both indoor and outdoor use, they bring a cheerful glow to any space.

1052552138.description: Hey, bread lovers! The Member's Mark French Baguette has a soft interior with a light and crispy exterior, making it the perfect complement to all sorts of dishes. This versatile bread is a game-changer for all kinds of meals and settings.

1052552139.description: Transform your holiday décor with the breathtaking Member's Mark 84" Prelit Nativity. Standing over 7 feet tall, this complete holy family display is pre-illuminated with 343 radiant LED lights, making it a stunning centerpiece for your Christmas celebrations. Designed to capture the quiet reverence and profound joy of the nativity scene, this set is perfect for both indoor and outdoor use.

1052552140.description: Hosting gatherings has never been easier with the Member's Mark Charcuterie Entertainment Tray. Perfect for both intimate and larger events, this ready-to-serve tray is thoughtfully curated to serve 10-12 people in just minutes. It features a delightful assortment of premium meats, cheeses, and accompaniments, ensuring a crowd-pleasing spread that's as convenient as it is delicious.

1052552141.description: Transform your holiday décor with the Member's Mark™ 6' Pre-Lit Grand Nutcracker with Carousel. Standing a striking six feet tall, this intricately designed nutcracker is dressed in a traditional uniform featuring vibrant red, deep navy, and gleaming gold accents. Its commanding presence makes it the perfect focal point for any festive setting.

1052552142.description: Member's Mark Boneless Center Cut Pork Loin Chops, priced per pound are ideal for baking, frying or grilling with 24g of protein per serving. Pick your favorite method and have dinner ready for the family without a ton of work. These boneless pork chops will be the star alongside your favorite side dishes like mashed potatoes and grilled vegetables. Use these pork chops for all of the baked pork chop recipes you love.

1052552143.description: Bring the festive spirit into your home with the Member's Mark Set of 2 Holiday Deer Decor, exclusive to Sam's Club. Crafted from high-quality polyresin, each deer is hand-painted in a stunning golden finish with verdigris accents that enhance the intricate carving details. Their realistic texture and soft, neutral tones make them a perfect fit for both modern and traditional homes.

1052552144.description: Immerse your home in the timeless charm of the holiday season with the Animated Storybook Decor. This stunning piece combines artistry, animation, and festive spirit, making it a perfect centerpiece for Christmas displays or a thoughtful gift for classic ballet enthusiasts.

1052552145.description: Transform your holiday décor with the Member's Mark™ 6' Pre-Lit Grand Nutcracker with Carousel. Standing a striking six feet tall, this intricately designed nutcracker is dressed in a traditional uniform featuring vibrant red, deep navy, and gleaming gold accents. Its commanding presence makes it the perfect focal point for any festive setting.

1052552146.description: Immerse your home in the timeless charm of the holiday season with the Animated Storybook Decor. This stunning piece combines artistry, animation, and festive spirit, making it a perfect centerpiece for Christmas displays or a thoughtful gift for classic ballet enthusiasts.

1052552147.description: Transform your holiday season with this stunning artificial tree, designed to bring the charm of nature into your home. Each tree features incredibly realistic, full branches that create a cozy and natural look, making it the perfect centerpiece for your festive decorations.

1052552148.description: Experience the magic of the Member's Mark 7' Slim Linden Fir Pre-Lit Christmas Tree, adorned with 400 color-changing LED lights featuring twinkling effects. This stunning tree creates a mesmerizing spectacle, adding a touch of splendor and natural beauty to your holiday celebrations.

1052552149.description: Elevate your festive decorations with the Member's Mark 12' Pre-Lit Multicolor Lightshow Tree. Featuring gracefully draped light strands from top to base and a pre-lit star crowning the design, this tree creates a mesmerizing display that will captivate everyone's attention.

1052552150.description: Transform your space into a winter wonderland with the Member's Mark 72'' Pre-Lit Crystal Iced Snowman. Standing an impressive 6 feet tall, this dazzling sculpture features a crystal-inspired acrylic body that sparkles like freshly fallen snow under moonlight. Perfect for indoor or covered outdoor use, it creates a captivating focal point for your holiday décor.

1052552151.description: Transform your holiday display with the Member's Mark 76" Pre-Lit Color-Changing Buck, available exclusively at Sam's Club. Standing tall at just over 76", this stunning buck features a sturdy metal frame and a light motion collar, making it a captivating centerpiece for your seasonal decorations.

1052552153.description: The Express Women's Fashion Scuba Top is the ultimate blend of style and comfort, perfect for your next getaway. Designed to transition seamlessly from daytime adventures to evening outings, this pullover is a must-have addition to your vacation wardrobe.

1052552154.description: The Woolrich Women's Wrap is designed to elevate your outerwear collection with its luxurious softness and unique design.
